[merged-gpt-6-luna-atleast2of3]
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
`:resource.azapi_resource.diag_settings` configures `workspaceId` from the management module's generated configuration, but does not depend on `:resource.azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management`. The diagnostic setting can be created before the workspace it targets exists.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The diagnostic settings use the Log Analytics workspace resource ID through a computed local but have no dependency on the workspace resource. Ordering the diagnostics after the workspace avoids creating settings against a workspace that is not yet provisioned.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The diagnostic-settings resource uses the Log Analytics workspace ID as its destination, but its configuration is supplied through locals/template variables and has no dependency on the managed workspace. If the workspace is created in this apply, diagnostic settings can be attempted before the destination exists.

----------------------------------------

[merged-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-atleast2of3]
[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run1]
azapi_resource.diag_settings publishes diagnostic settings whose workspaceId is derived only from a plain string (local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id), so Terraform has no ordering edge to azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management. When deploy_management_resources is true this module creates that workspace; without a dependency the diagnostic settings (and the DDOS/diag policies) can be applied before the destination Log Analytics workspace exists. Add a dependency (e.g. depends_on) on azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run2]
azapi_resource.diag_settings sends its diagnostic logs to `workspaceId = local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id`, which is only a string derived from module outputs (no resource reference is created). Its depends_on only covers the Management Group hierarchy and time_sleep.after_azurerm_management_group, so the subscription/tenant-level diagnostic setting can be created before azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management exists and the Azure API call will fail. It must be ordered after the Log Analytics workspace (which in turn follows azurerm_resource_group.management).

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
azapi_resource.diag_settings creates a diagnostic setting whose `workspaceId` is `local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id`, i.e. the Log Analytics workspace managed by azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management, but it only depends on the management groups and time_sleep.after_azurerm_management_group. Nothing orders it after the workspace, so the diagnostic setting can be applied before the workspace exists and fail with a not-found workspace.

----------------------------------------

[merged-glm-5.3-flash-atleast2of3]
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
azapi_resource.diag_settings writes `workspaceId = local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id` into its body, but that resource ID is a plain string built from locals/variables — no attribute reference or depends_on ties it to azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management. When deploy_diagnostics_for_mg and deploy_management_resources are both enabled, the diagnostic settings can be created before the module-managed Log Analytics workspace exists, causing a 404/failure from the ARM API. Add azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management to its depends_on (the existing depends_on only covers the Management Groups).

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run3]
azapi_resource.diag_settings sets body.properties.workspaceId to local.template_file_variables.log_analytics_workspace_resource_id, which is a static string derived from the management sub-module configuration and creates no Terraform data dependency on azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management. When the Log Analytics workspace is created in the same apply (deploy_management_resources = true), the Management Group diagnostic settings can be created before the workspace exists and will fail. azapi_resource.data_collection_rule targeting the same workspace already declares this depends_on.
